synth.notes:
Mirror-axis game on a 21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks (x-major). Model: axis row, selection, piece block sets, target block sets.
A1/A2 move the selection x-/+3; A3/A4 move a piece y-/+3 (a no-op for the axis); A5 cycles axis->pieces by rank->axis.
Reflections are piece blocks mirrored across the axis (2a-bx), clipped to the board. Render layers wall<target<reflection<piece, then re-extract 4-connected components (targets per id; wall index offset by the non-wall 0 pixels).
Holes: the selected piece shows 0 and a reflection shows 4 unless a lower pixel shows through. Merged pieces are split statelessly by the 0-centre blocks. Passes 29/29 with and without hidden state.
Unconfirmed (never observed): the A5 order beyond axis->first piece, and the blocking rules (piece vs axis row or other pieces, axis vs piece rows).
